sloka: दीप्यमानं स्वया लक्ष्म्या विरजोम्बरधारिणम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श पितरं विभुः ।। ६.१२२.१० ।।
transliteration: dīpyamānaṁ svayā lakṣmyā virajombaradhāriṇam ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dadarśa pitaraṁ vibhuḥ ।। 6.122.10 ।।

translations.english: Raghava with his younger brother Lakshmana saw his father who was effulgent, blazing and adorned in white clothes.
